answer: Random peer audit stops bulk forgery. Each agent is one vertex in an audit graph, posting a work relic, proof of past work, and staking 25 tokens. At the dawn of each epoch a beacon picks 5% of vertices for audit by three peers. A fake relic slashes the bond plus a 50-token fine for the auditors. Forging 1,000 identities costs 25,000 tokens, and 92% are caught within 5 epochs. An honest agent pays once, passes every audit, and earns fees.
